name: TAF Inpatient Claims Line
description: Line-level inpatient records from the CMS T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF). Each row represents one service line on an inpatient facility claim submitted to Medicaid, containing procedure codes, revenue codes, service dates, units of service, and line-level payment information.

content.clm_id: String: Unique claim identifier linking to the IP Header record
content.msis_ident_num: String: Medicaid system identifier number assigned by the state
content.year: Int32: Reference year of the claim
content.line_num: Int32: Sequential service line number within the claim
content.rev_cd: String: Revenue center code identifying the type of accommodation or ancillary service
content.srvc_bgn_dt: Date32[day]: Service begin date for this line item
content.srvc_end_dt: Date32[day]: Service end date for this line item
content.proc_cd: String: Procedure code (HCPCS/CPT) for this service line
content.ndc_cd: String: National Drug Code (NDC) if applicable
content.unt_cnt: Double: Units of service for this line item
content.mdcd_pd_amt: Double: Medicaid paid amount for this line item
content.alowd_amt: Double: Allowed amount for this line item
content.bene_coinsrnc_amt: Double: Beneficiary coinsurance amount for this line item
content.bene_ddctbl_amt: String: Beneficiary deductible amount for this line item
content.othr_insrnc_amt: Double: Other insurance paid amount for this line item
